summary: Iteration-2 full test pass (backend + frontend) on LNMO School ERP. Backend: 45 new pytest cases for lookups, academic years, enrollments, teacher assignments, attendance sheet/records, marks + publish, teacher workspace and global search — all pass; iteration-1 regression suite 36/36 still passes (81/81 total). Frontend (Playwright, preview URL): verified admin academic-year create, enrollment create with dynamic optionsUrl selects + student class/section propagation, teacher-assignment lookup/name resolution, full attendance flow (load, P/A/L toggles, mark-all-present, save draft, submit final, finalized badge, history counts), assessment create -> 'Enter marks' row action -> marks grid (keyboard Enter nav, invalid>max red border + validation msg + blocked save with error toast, absent/exempt disables score, persistence, publish lock + Published badge, unpublish), teacher login redirect to /teacher/dashboard with correct stats/assignments, /teacher/students class selector, teacher attendance locked state on finalized sheet + draft save on open sheet, teacher /app/* -> /access-denied, Cmd+K/Ctrl+K palette in platform/institution/teacher consoles with backend results, ?q= prefill and Pages navigation, plus regression on students CRUD, dashboards and audit log. One real authorization gap found (teacher marks access to unassigned classes) plus several code-quality/data-integrity issues. All QA-created throwaway data was removed and Greenwood demo data restored (Aarav Shah -> Grade 6/A/2026-27, 'Unit Test 1' left Published).

critical.issue: Missing ensure_class_access for teachers: a teacher can READ (200) and WRITE (200) marks for an assessment belonging to a class/section they are NOT assigned to (verified with an assessment for Grade 11/Z while teacher is only assigned Grade 6/A). Attendance endpoints enforce this, marks do not.

minor.issue: Entries are validated inside the write loop, so an invalid score mid-payload leaves earlier entries already persisted (partial write). Validate the whole payload before any db write.

Cascade delete only covers users/students/teachers/classes/sections/subjects — academic_years, enrollments, teacher_assignments, assessments, attendance and marks are orphaned after institution deletion (cross-tenant data leftovers).
Deleting an assessment leaves its marks documents orphaned (verified: 2 orphan marks rows remained after deleting a test assessment).

No uniqueness/validation on (student_id, academic_year): the same student can be enrolled repeatedly, and each new enrollment silently overwrites the student's class/section/academic_year while old enrollment rows remain, so the list can show contradicting rows. Deleting an enrollment also does not revert the student record.

section is optional; when admin loads 'All sections' the sheet is saved under section="" for the same class/date as a separate record from per-section sheets, so per-section and all-section records can disagree for the same day.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' plus 'access-control-allow-credentials: true' — an invalid/unsafe combination (playbook requires explicit origins). Set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit preview origin.

ui_bugs.issue: No loading state: while /api/teacher/overview is in flight the page renders the 'No classes assigned yet' empty state and '—' stats, so an assigned teacher sees a misleading 'not assigned' message for ~1s on every load (data renders correctly afterwards). Add a skeleton/loading guard like MarksEntryPage has.
Console a11y error on every open: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' — add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to the CommandDialog.

issues: Status cell uses a native HTML <select> (browser-rendered dropdown) instead of the shadcn Select used everywhere else — inconsistent look and different keyboard/interaction model in an otherwise polished grid.
Date fields use the browser-native <input type="date"> picker rather than a shadcn calendar/date-picker component, inconsistent with the design system.
Seeded '2026-27' row shows '—' for start/end date because the seed omits dates; consider backfilling so the flagship demo record looks complete.

action_items: HIGH: call ensure_class_access(user, assessment.class_name, assessment.section) in both GET and POST /api/assessments/{aid}/marks so teachers cannot read/write marks for unassigned classes (re-run /app/backend/tests/test_marks_authz.py to verify).
Validate all marks entries before writing any of them (avoid partial persistence on a 400).
Extend institution cascade delete (and assessment delete) to academic_years/enrollments/teacher_assignments/assessments/attendance/marks.
Add (student_id, academic_year) dedupe/upsert for enrollments and decide the rule for reverting student class/section when an enrollment is deleted.
Add a loading skeleton to TeacherDashboard so the 'No classes assigned yet' empty state does not flash for assigned teachers.
Replace the native <select> in the marks grid status column with the shadcn Select (and consider a shadcn date picker for date fields).
Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to CommandDialog to clear the a11y console error.
Set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend origin instead of '*' (credentials + wildcard is invalid).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 720 lines and now mixes auth, generic CRUD, attendance, marks, teacher workspace and search — split into routers (auth/resources/academics/teacher/search) before it grows further.
Marks endpoints are the only class-scoped endpoints missing the ensure_class_access guard used by attendance — the guard should be applied centrally rather than per-endpoint.
enrich_institution_doc mutates the students collection as a side effect of enrollment create/update; this cross-collection write has no rollback if the subsequent insert fails.

Attendance and marks payloads are raw dicts with manual validation; introduce Pydantic models so status/date/score types are validated consistently (server currently silently drops unknown attendance statuses instead of reporting a 400).

success_rate.backend: 98% (81/82 pass; the single failure is the intentional teacher-marks-authorization probe)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows functional (2 non-blocking UI issues)

rca_of_the_issue: Marks authorization gap: ensure_class_access() is invoked by /api/attendance/sheet and /api/teacher/students but not by /api/assessments/{aid}/marks (GET or POST), which only checks role in (institution_admin, teacher) and institution_id. Reproduction: admin creates an assessment for class 'Grade 11' section 'Z'; the Grade 6/A teacher then GETs and POSTs /api/assessments/{id}/marks and both return 200. Mitigation: after loading the assessment, call await ensure_class_access(user, assessment.get('class_name'), assessment.get('section') or '') in both handlers.
